text:
samir: Quick FYI  I'm going to land a focused quickstart refresh that does: (1) align snippets with SDK v8, (2) switch examples to REDWOOD_TOKEN, (3) replace the big Dockerfile with a compact multistage, and (4) fix one internal link the checker flagged. Planning a single small PR with atomic commits.
ivy: Sounds good. Will this include the CLI credential helper or stick to env vars?
samir: For this PR keep env var first; small experimental auth helper will be a follow-up. But I'll add a short note "Where to find your token" pointing to Console -> API keys.
paul: Can you paste the new JS + Py snippets so I can run snippet-runner locally? I can also run the docs build.
samir: JS snippet:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const out = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello, quickstart!' });
console.log(out.output_text || out.output[0].content);
```
Py snippet:```py
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_TOKEN'))
resp = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello, quickstart!')
print(getattr(resp, 'output_text', resp.output[0].content))
```
maya: Nice. Two quick asks: (a) add a one-liner on token precedence in the auth section (env var > interactive) and (b) keep the Docker example <= 3 RUN lines so its approachable for new users.
samir: Will do both. I'll make the Dockerfile a tidy multistage and add a short note about not baking tokens into images + .gitignore snippet.
docs-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 3098765450.
paul: Ran the snippet-runner in a linux container: found one README code block still referencing REDWOOD_API_KEY and a stray trailing comma in the Python example that trips older Python patch releases. I can open a tiny PR against your branch with fixes if you want.
samir: Please open it against my branch and tag me. I'll squash the fixes into the PR.
ivy: Linkchecker also flagged `/docs/getting-started/auth` as 404; we now use `/docs/getting-started/credentials`. Can you sweep internal links?
samir: Good catch. I'll run linkchecker locally before final push and add a redirect entry.
docs-bot: snippet-runner finished: 1 warning (trailing comma in python example), 0 errors.
paul: I pushed the tiny fix branch to your fork: `samir/qs-fix-trailing-comma`. Opened PR against your branch.
samir: Got it, merging that into my branch now. Plan: open main PR in ~20m, request reviews from @ivy and @paul. CI checks to pass: docs build, snippet-runner, linkchecker.
maya: Minor doc-nit: update sample output to be deterministic text instead of printing raw objects. People copy/paste and get confusing output.
samir: Agree. I'll normalize examples to `out.output_text` when available.
docs-bot: linkchecker run queued for docs/quickstart at 3098765470.
leo: Quick UX note: consider a compact "single-file" tab that shows the minimal flow (JS + run) for people who want to get started fast. Full example in an expandable section.
samir: Nice idea, but separate PR. I'll leave a TODO in the PR description to follow up.
paul: Ready to review once PR is up. Ping me here.
samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612  Assigning @ivy @paul for review. Will attach a screenshot placeholder for the token location and add the redirect after approvals.
ivy: On it.
samir: Closing thread after merge. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
